name: show_changes
description: Show all file changes recorded in the current session (plus optional git diff fallback). Returns a compact summary with per-file status and a unified diff snippet. Use this before concluding a task to verify modifications.

path.description: Optional file path filter — when set, only changes touching this path (substring match) are shown.

include_git.description: When true (default), include `git diff`/`git status` as fallback when the session mutation log is empty. Set false to show only explicit session writes/patches.

limit_snippet.description: Maximum lines of unified diff snippet to include (default 120, 0 = header only).
